g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS02 Switching the Active Kitchen Configuration (AC 4)
Precondition: KCF-00001 "Compact kitchen" (12 x 8 x 3.2 m, line on the NORTH wall) is ACTIVE and shown
The viewer never keeps a previous layout: every load rebuilds the scene from the configuration that is
ACTIVE at that moment (VIS01 BR 4 / BR 8). A module instance is never reused between loads.
